notes.title: Development Update #1
notes.content:
[b]Get ready for an intense psychological horror experience like never before! [/b]

Embark on a chilling journey into the unknown with our upcoming game, "Unknown Memoirs: Stormy Night." As the Never Ending Storm wreaks havoc, prepare to delve into a world filled with paranormal events and spine-tingling horrors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44819122/22bf85726628fe36a5f853414b1d9a047772def9.png[/img]

Synopsis:

"Stormy Night" plunges players into the eerie chaos brought by an endless storm. Strange sightings and disturbing occurrences escalate as the storm rages into its third week. Trapped within the confines of your apartment, you're thrust into a nightmarish spiral induced by the storm's sinister presence.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44819122/520590f60b7bcfe4745cd3a9fff422ac7af9ea3a.png[/img]

Gameplay Features: 

[list]
[*] [b]Walking Simulator Genre[/b]: Immerse yourself in a narrative-driven experience.
[*] [b]Realism-driven Gameplay[/b]: Experience a world where reality blurs with horror.
[*] [b]Unique 4:3 Aspect Ratio[/b]: Capturing the essence of "found footage" for added immersion.
[*] [b]Interactive Physics Objects[/b]: Engage with various in-game objects for a deeper connection.
[*] [b]Mature Content Warning[/b]: Brace for intense psychological horror elements, blood depictions, terrifying monsters, and disturbing imagery. This game is tailored for mature audiences and isn't suitable for children or those sensitive to horror and mature themes.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44060620/7a5acecab4ce8ad00ae5362084fd1e75082b5eb0.gif[/img]

Stay tuned for updates and prepare to face your fears when "Unknown Memoirs: Stormy Night" arrives in the coming months on Steam. Are you ready to step into the eye of the storm?

[h1]Wishlist the "Stormy Night" here: [/h1] [h2][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2760610/Unknown_Memoirs_Stormy_Night/]Unknown Memoirs: Stormy Night[/url][/h2]
